title: Native versus paid plugins
control: Reuse Django/Celery/Valkey and official APIs; benchmark paid alternatives before enabling
acceptance: Zero unapproved paid calls; compare full TCO including maintenance and data rights

title: Model and token costs
control: Rules first; smaller models for extraction; retrieve minimal approved context; bound output and retry tokens
acceptance: Track INR/task and token totals; candidate meets approved quality floor before activation

title: Research and contact costs
control: Deduplicate permitted evidence by source and freshness; prioritize official sources and verification
acceptance: Cost per qualified verified opportunity improves vs approved baseline without precision or coverage regression

title: Cloud and worker sizing
control: Right-size with measurements; scale queues from age/depth; use budgets not CPU alone; review idle capacity
acceptance: Track cost/1000 tasks and queue age; no SLO violation during right-sizing

title: Storage and retention costs
control: Archive allowed aged evidence; lifecycle rules respect legal hold; compress permitted artifacts
acceptance: Measure GB-month and restore test; no deletion of held or authoritative financial records

title: Communication and subscription costs
control: Suppress duplicate/ineligible outreach; stop on reply; review unused seats and API entitlements
acceptance: Zero disallowed dispatches; compare cost per meaningful response and verified conversion

title: Budget reservation
control: Atomic reservation for maximum external cost across tenant/startup/action; reconcile billed actual, release unused
acceptance: Zero unauthorized overspend under parallel reservation test; reconcile all metered costs

title: Usage anomaly control
control: Alert 70/90% of configured cap (proposed); pause optional jobs at cap; route unexpected bills to owner
acceptance: No live paid fallback on exhaustion; alerts and pause observed in simulated spend spike

title: Startup templates and tenants
control: Configurable onboarding with schema validation and independent ownership; no per-startup hardcoding
acceptance: 25 owned +10 external initial; 50+ owned +100 external growth validation

title: Concurrent users and jobs
control: Stateless API, independent worker scaling and resource caps
acceptance: 50/250 staff sessions; 50/250 concurrent jobs initial/growth

title: Data and scheduling volume
control: Seed scoped 100k/1m opportunities and 10k/100k actions per day; burst/soak profiles
acceptance: Meet workload-specific p95, queue age and durability targets; document actual capacity

title: Regional expansion
control: Explicit locale, time zone, currency and residence rules; keep region selection policy-based
acceptance: Verify local display and same-currency accounting; no unauthorized cross-region transfer

title: Noisy neighbor and capacity
control: Per-tenant concurrency, quota and fair queue; test one overloaded tenant vs others
acceptance: No cross-tenant disclosure or starvation; demonstrate isolation and measure saturation

title: Modular monolith
control: Separate investment/commercial Django domains; split services only with measured need
acceptance: ADR justifies each runtime dependency; no duplicated core workflow framework per startup

title: Four frontends and two backends
control: Keep independent deployables and data planes; reuse code not secrets/operational records
acceptance: Build matrix and access tests demonstrate independent deployment and rollback

title: Domain and adapter boundaries
control: Typed service, event, AI gateway and provider interfaces; external calls outside DB transaction
acceptance: Unit and contract tests cover adapter failures; no circular dependencies

title: Configuration-driven design
control: Validate business templates, filter schemas, policy versions and activation readiness
acceptance: New standard startup profile configured without core code changes; invalid config rejected

title: Complexity and reuse review
control: Remove measured duplicates; retain financial separation and meaningful contracts
acceptance: No arbitrary reductions in UI/API/table counts; document before/after dependency and test impact

title: Code health
control: Typed contracts, small modules, lint, tests, review AI code, isolate provider specifics
acceptance: No unresolved blocking lint/test or known exploitable critical dependency at merge

title: Shared code libraries
control: Reusable React, scoped Python, AI gateway, workflow, adapter and test packages; independent runtime configs
acceptance: New standard profile uses shared code; no common secrets, queues or confidential databases

title: Template reuse
control: Version and approve templates, rules, filters, workflows and role presets
acceptance: Configure new startup and external tenant; no inherited private records

title: Component contracts
control: Typed inputs and stable interfaces with extension points; avoid fork per tenant
acceptance: Consumer contract tests pass for both products independently

title: Standard setup
control: Reproducible local environments and typed scaffolding; existing identity reuse verified
acceptance: Fresh authorized developer runs offline checks using documented steps

title: Vertical slices and estimates
control: Implement UI/API/DB/worker together, use predecessor graph and role capacity; avoid duplicated work
acceptance: Track PD actual vs estimate and rework; no unchecked dependency or double counting

title: AI-assisted development
control: Review generated code, secrets, licences, dependency and test impact; no blind merge
acceptance: Independent review and mandatory CI evidence for every change

title: Unit economics
control: Separate SaaS billing from issuer funds or customer receipts; allocate AI, provider, infra and support costs
acceptance: Contribution margin per tenant = service revenue minus attributable/allocated delivery costs; report basis

title: Entitlements and usage
control: Version plans, quotas and pricing; reconcile metered usage and credits; use client-approved credentials
acceptance: 100% attributable usage reconciled; no charge or service outside entitlement

title: Support and renewal
control: Track onboarding effort, support tickets, renewal/churn and service commitments
acceptance: Measure contribution margin and churn by cohort; no unverified SLA promise

title: Client scalability and portability
control: Self-service standard onboarding; custom needs separately estimated; export and revoke on offboard
acceptance: Onboarding time and support cost improve vs baseline with isolation and retention intact

title: Daily planning and discovery
control: Scheduled objectives, source permissions, freshness, target segments and bounded search budget
acceptance: Eligible plan produced per schedule; missed runs recover once; prohibited source never fetched

title: Qualification and verification
control: Classify with rules and AI; evidence required; deduplicate and verify professional contacts
acceptance: Precision >=90% on approved benchmark; uncertain items routed to review

title: Outreach and response
control: Approved audience and channel eligibility; recheck at dispatch; classify replies and stop irrelevant sequences
acceptance: Zero sends to ineligible/suppressed recipient; substantive reply cancels pending generic follow-up

title: Objection and meetings
control: Retrieve approved evidence, abstain/escalate unresolved claims; verify availability and timezone
acceptance: No unsupported promises or double-booking; all unresolved cases get assigned task

title: Documents and approvals
control: Draft from approved templates; snapshot hashes; verify required human approval before formal action
acceptance: Zero execution with stale or missing mandatory approval; simulation sends nothing

title: Financial and business closure
control: Process verified callbacks; reconcile correct legal entity and currency; require route-specific conditions
acceptance: Zero duplicate side effects; 100% verified transactions reconciled before closure

title: Exception and learning
control: Retry only known-safe transient failures; unknown outcome reconcile; feedback suggests changes rather than self-publishing
acceptance: Workflow completion >=99% of eligible due runs within agreed window; no blind repeat

title: Autonomy and stop controls
control: Manual, assisted, supervised and controlled autonomous; per-workflow policy; emergency stop, simulation and dry run
acceptance: Target >=90% eligible steps automated; stop prevents future external calls, no bypass of mandatory approval

title: Transactional outbox
control: Write business state and event atomically; lease delivery; idempotent consumer
acceptance: Crash between commit and publish recovers; no lost committed event

title: Idempotency and concurrency
control: Unique scoped action key plus payload fingerprint; lock state and budget; reject mismatched key reuse
acceptance: Replay same event returns same result; concurrent test yields one side effect

title: Timeout and retry
control: Bound provider timeout; jittered exponential backoff; circuit breaker; dead-letter with redacted evidence
acceptance: Permanent errors not retried; unknown outcome moves to reconciliation; no retry storm

title: Durable workflow state
control: Persist step and attempt; resume after worker restart; cancel and lease fencing
acceptance: Killed worker resumes safely or reconciles; no unauthorized or duplicate dispatch

title: Backpressure and fair scheduling
control: Cap in-flight jobs by tenant and class; reserve urgent queue capacity; reject overload explicitly
acceptance: No tenant starvation under load; queue age and rate-limit metrics collected

title: Config and AI failures
control: Fail startup on missing mandatory config; validate structured AI; fallback only approved and within budget
acceptance: No silent unsafe defaults or invalid persisted AI decisions

title: Availability and reconciliation
control: Health/readiness checks, independent financial verification, alert and restore drills
acceptance: Proposed 99.9% critical availability over rolling 30 days; no unresolved critical financial mismatch

title: Typed contracts
control: Review all methods, request/response types, errors, authorization and idempotency; resolve draft gaps
acceptance: 100% applicable approved contracts before activation; run schema and contract tests

title: Rules-first model routing
control: Deterministic calculations/permissions/state; retrieval/rules then small model; advanced reasoning only when required
acceptance: Compare quality, latency and INR per task on same approved dataset

title: Provenance and source rights
control: Record approved URL/source, fetch date, licence/permission and confidence; do not scrape private data
acceptance: 100% actionable records have permitted provenance; missing rights quarantined

title: Authentication and privileged sessions
control: Reuse verified identity; separate product/audience; MFA for privileged roles; expire and revoke sessions
acceptance: Zero successful revoked, wrong-audience or unauthorized privileged requests; test revoked sessions and MFA bypass

title: Normalization and ownership
control: Normalize transaction records; validated JSONB for flexible attributes; tenant/startup scoped FKs
acceptance: No orphan or cross-scope reference in migration and negative tests

title: Independent CI/CD
control: Separate pipelines, environments, identities and artifacts; build once, promote immutable digest
acceptance: Authorized staging rehearsal and rollback for each frontend/backend/worker independently

title: Public website assets
control: Compress images, CDN for approved snapshots, defer nonessential JS, split bundles; measure real-user cohorts
acceptance: LCP p75 <=2.5s; INP p75 <=200ms; CLS p75 <=0.1 on approved representative devices

title: Query plans and indexes
control: Use staging EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on authorized representative reads; index actual predicates
acceptance: Measure plan time, reads and write overhead; avoid speculative indexing

title: ORM and connections
control: select_related/prefetch when needed, projected fields, bounded transaction and pool sizing
acceptance: No N+1 regression in representative list; monitor connection saturation

title: Financial storage
control: Decimal, currency, receipts, allocations, reversals and reconciliation independently tracked
acceptance: Exact synthetic amounts; no float rounding or duplicate allocation

title: Vector and cache lifecycle
control: Scope before retrieval, version embeddings, invalidate on permission or knowledge change
acceptance: No cross-scope vector match; compare recall/latency and storage before tuning

title: Migration and archive
control: Expand/backfill/validate/contract; legal hold; test backward compatibility and restore
acceptance: Zero unapproved data loss; approved rollback or forward repair; record reconciled row counts

title: Consolidation and batching
control: Reuse endpoints only for same scope and semantics; stable pagination and minimal serializers
acceptance: Compare API calls and bytes; no unauthorized field or generic bypass

title: Adapter reliability
control: Standard timeouts, rate limits, circuit breakers and explicit entitlement fallback
acceptance: Contract tests for timeout, rate-limit, malformed and unknown outcomes

title: Webhook processing
control: Verify signature and replay window; durable deduplication before acknowledgement
acceptance: Invalid signatures rejected; repeat verified event no second effect; p95 ACK <=2s

title: API costs and monitoring
control: Meter by provider, operation, tenant/startup; limit optional calls and use permitted caching
acceptance: All attributable consumption metered; no unapproved paid provider calls

title: Technical debt
control: Track issue, owner, severity, business impact and refactor benefit
acceptance: Review monthly; each accepted change has regression evidence and rollback

title: Documentation and debugging
control: Keep contract docs and runbooks synchronized with actual code; structured redacted errors
acceptance: New maintainer can reproduce test and diagnose synthetic failure using runbook

title: Dependencies and compatibility
control: Pin audited dependencies; upgrade in isolated branch; monitor deprecations
acceptance: All mandatory compatibility and regression tests pass before activation

title: Risk-based tests
control: Cover positive, invalid, boundary, concurrency and recovery cases by operation; synthetic scoped fixtures
acceptance: 100% mandatory product regression passed at gate; no product tests marked pass without execution
